question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

My cousin’s __fanatical__ views made him very unpopular with his friends.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Moderate.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word** 'fanatical' **is **'moderate'.**
 
• **Fanatical**; motivated or characterized by an extreme.(कट्टर)
 
 
• **Example**- That was one thing that bound us together our fanatical attention to detail.
 
 
 
• **Moderate;** average in size or amount neither too much nor too little. (मध्यम)
 
 
• **​Example**- Heat the olive oil over a moderate flame.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym is **'moderate'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Apathetic'**- lacking interest or desire to act.(उदासीन)
 
• '**Impartial**'- not supporting one person or group more than another.(निष्पक्ष)
 
• '**Weary'**- very tired.(सुस्त)
